objective: Continuation authorized by the owner on 2026-10-30 ('Yes, let's continue.'), taking the recommendation of THREEFOLD-SPACES-20261030-001: prove that every non-2-colourable 3-regular triple system (the dual of a three-fold space of the knot) is assembled from Fano blocks by splices and odd cycles, and extend the SAT census to pieces with a repeated point on a line. Scoping before activation (not evidence) refuted the approved form: three twisted 14-point pieces attached to the cube (the 4-point triple system whose incidence graph is the cube), at a sign pattern with one negation per face, give a 43-point system that is not 2-colourable and is neither a Fano composition nor a cycle of Fano blocks. The reading adopted (the more interesting one, under the owner's standing rule): the glue is any planar connector obeying Kasteleyn's face parity, odd cycles being the simplest, and the open question is whether the Fano plane is the only leaf of the decomposition. Questions: (A) the structure of tight-cut decompositions of non-colourable cubic triple systems (multigraph pieces, leaves, twists), the one-twist lemma for cubic braces and the resulting Fano-leaf theorem, and the converse construction from Kasteleyn-signed planar connectors; (B) the census of small non-colourable cubic systems with repeated points (untwisted and twisted), and all twisted 14-point systems. Intuitions targeted: space from logic (the knot's self-built space: Fano atoms and planar glue); the two/three boundary. No time constraints.
status: Complete: the knot's three-fold spaces are Fano atoms in planar Pfaffian glue (Fano-leaf theorem unconditional; every planar cubic graph is glue; approved grammar refuted by the 43-point twisted cube); census of cores to 10 points; spaces up to 22 points have 7, 13, 19, 21 or 22 points. Recommendation: Continue (fresh epic), the surfaces of three-fold spaces (2/3).
stop_rule: Stop when (i) the decomposition structure is proved and the Fano-leaf theorem is proved or reduced to a stated lemma with its proved cases; (ii) the converse construction is proved with examples beyond odd cycles; (iii) the census with repeated points and the twisted 14-point enumeration are done; (iv) the decision note records the recommendation.
